name: website_https
description: An Ansible playbook that prepares an Ubuntu Apache web server, installs Apache and OpenSSL packages, creates a self-signed TLS certificate, publishes a Hello World site, and configures HTTPS.

name: poodle_fix
description: An Ansible playbook that restricts Apache SSL protocols to TLS 1.2 and restarts affected services to remediate insecure SSL configuration.

name: website_https_verification
description: A Chef InSpec verification profile that tests HTTPS availability, expected site content, SSLv3 disablement, and TLS 1.2 support.

name: ssh_root_login_control
description: A Chef InSpec compliance control that verifies SSH root login is disabled and records related OpenSSH and RHEL 8 STIG metadata.

name: chef_automate_deployment
description: A bootstrap script that deploys Chef Automate with Chef Infra Server, configures host and kernel settings, and creates Chef users and organizations with generated credentials.

name: chef_server_deployment
description: A bootstrap script that deploys standalone Chef Infra Server, configures host and kernel settings, and creates a Chef user and organization with PEM credentials.
